stories.h: Tangled quantum whirlpools caught unraveling in an ultracold gas
stories.t: When a cloud of atoms is cooled close to absolute zero, its atoms can merge into a Bose–Einstein condensate (BEC): an exotic fluid in which atoms across the whole cloud share a single quantum state.

stories.h: Vitamin C could help block cancer-linked chemicals in your stomach, study finds
stories.t: Scientists have discovered that vitamin C may help prevent potentially cancer-causing chemicals from forming in the stomach after eating foods containing nitrates and nitrites.
